title: On the Laplacian spectral gap of generalized pancake graphs
summary: The generalized pancake graph $P(m,n)$ is the Cayley graph of the group of colored permutations $\mathbb{Z}_m\wr S_n=(\mathbb{Z}_m)^n\rtimes S_n$ generated by generalized prefix reversals. In this paper, we establish that, for all $m,n\geq2$, the spectral gap $γ(P(m,n))$ of the normalized Laplacian satisfies $α_m/n\leqγ(P(m,n))\leq1/n$, where $α_m$ is a positive constant that depends only on $m$.
